statement: ∀ (X : Type) [PseudoEMetricSpace X] (a δ : ℝ) (A : Set X) (V : ℕ → Set X), YuiCover δ A V → YuiContent a δ A ≤ YuiCost a V
proof:
intro X _ a δ A V hV
exact iInf_le_of_le V (iInf_le_of_le hV (le_refl (YuiCost a V)))
